data.generation: Prepare only fixed-draw unique TRAIN scenes and all144 VALIDATION scenes. Old native128 cached sensors read-only; new256/512 continuous geometry plus native DDA, never resize.
data.frame: Public20m square; radius8m, sensor5m/256first-hit rays, 3poses. Same physicalworld/trajectory/graph across resolution for fixedN. Not varied physicalscale or general building distribution.
data.bank_get: Read-only pinned after preparation; no implicit cache generation/GT completion/learned-factor cache.
data.targets: AtR0/1/2/4/8 use actual selected-forest arrived original-source union only. No all-radius shortcuts. Target map and doormask never enter source or decoder.

model.execution_adapter: Apply explicit tested FixedNativePool4 after construction/restore; original typed model/source and all parameter shapes remain unchanged. FP32 neural/FP64 GBP; no AMP/TF32.
model.spatial_invariance: FixedN and fixed source-set FLOAT only. Profile4 whole-packet exponent can couple addresses; empty-source prior shares can alter covariance.

training.loss: KnownBCE on every native pixel plus wallBCE only target-known pixels, per-recipient normalization; equal stages and equal H/rooms/N macroblock draws.
training.implementation: Exact tested staged readout backward then one original-live-feature source/GBP backward, all pixels/stages/agents retained.
training.budget_qualification: 2160 is a bounded structural learning pilot, not convergence. Incomplete pair cannot pass; keep partial checkpoints/failures. Preparation time, actual training/validation/IO time all reported separately.

validation.fixed_thresholds: known_logit>=0 and wall_logit>=0; ternaryraw, no postprocessing/own-overwrite/oracle.
validation.save: Raw original maps, actual-reached targets, raw predictions, factors, allroundbeliefs/codes, physical/selectedgraphs, door_masks, contexts and actual172B packets with hashes for every case. Atendpoint save full native known/wall logits for preregistered index0,N16,R0/R8 allH/rooms only; no outcome-based case choice.
validation.numeric_audit: Existing receive-only actualpacket auditor everycase; repeated/stale packets rejected without confidence inflation; replay bytes separately recorded as diagnostic extra sends.
validation.metrics: Own/union/peer typedaccuracy; wallprecision/recall/F1; unknownfalseknown; doorfreerecall; exact4neighbor connectivity; counts and physical/routehop coverage.
validation.aggregation: Equal Hxrooms(9cells), within cell equal N8/N16, withinN equalworlds. Preserve everyR/H/rooms/N result and node denominators; no pixel-weighted macro or successcase selection.
validation.split_status: Reused development VALIDATION, not independent TEST. Strong old128 evidence is unmatched historical reference only, not same initialization or joint-native training budget.

gate.K0_qualification: Endpoint necessary condition for interpreting fusion mechanism, not early stopping or a capacity impossibility theorem. Still report all results on failure.

communication.accounting: Record actual serialized sends and source-arrival coverage at everypaidround. Setup/publicframe/forestdiscovery/radio are unmeasured, not0. No100xclaim from data-only packet dimensions; fairraw transcript remains separate CPU audit.

preserved_reference.v304_failed_observed_diagonal: Preserve both fixed2000 endpoints, audited failures and no-restart decision.
preserved_reference.v263_counterevidence: Earlier spatial64's wallF1 gain accompanied severe topology failure; newlocal model must report topology, not infer success from capacity or localization.

post_training: After this pair completes, audit actual raw maps and packets, then independent multiagent first-principles reviews of representation/objective/inference/data. One high-leverage next intervention only after evidence; no automatic extension or tuning sweep.
